purpose: Records the two human-confirmed contract interpretations that were in force for the authorized single Final Test pass. This record is NOT part of the sealed output package: it is not listed in metadata_and_hashes_stage129_final_test_execution.json and it changes no hashed artifact. It exists because the executor's own provenance record is sealed by its SHA-256 at write time and therefore cannot carry a note added after the fact.

interpretations.subject: bootstrap_execution_authorized_by_this_contract
interpretations.human_confirmed_reading: The prohibition is scoped to the contract-lock ACTION itself. PR #91 locked the bootstrap parameters prospectively and executed nothing; the false value states that the act of locking did not authorize a bootstrap run. It is not a standing prohibition on a later, separately authorized execution of the same contract.
interpretations.consequence: The independent PRE01 human authorization permits execution of the complete contract, including the locked paired company-cluster bootstrap with its frozen parameters (2000 replicates, minimum 1000 valid, percentile-95, seed 20260724).

interpretations.subject: usable_for_final_test
interpretations.human_confirmed_reading: The false value is the HISTORICAL state of the moment it was written, when PRE02 had resolved but PRE01 had not. It records that the admitted threshold could not yet be used, not that it may never be used.
interpretations.consequence: The independent PRE01 record SUPERSEDES this key, in the same way PRE01 supersedes the three contract keys it names. The threshold value 0.426878838687 is applied unchanged.

invocation.write_flag_note: --execute-final-test is the entry-point gate; without --write the executor self-labels the run a dry run and emits no package. PRE01 excludes 'any computational dry run' and the mission requires the written artifacts to be re-read, so --write is required for the authorized pass to be the real one.

reporting_limitations.subject: confidence_interval_coverage_across_the_five_contracted_metrics
reporting_limitations.produced_by: the executor frozen before access, at SHA-256 d85234ee4c7e2b14dc21084348a059fceb083cf8bcc0ecbf30ee64eef79c56a4
reporting_limitations.statement: The merged contract fixes the bootstrap method, cluster, replicate count, minimum valid count, percentile and seed, but does not state which of the five metrics receive an interval. The executor frozen before access produced intervals for three of them. This is recorded as a REPORTING LIMITATION of the single authorized pass. It is NOT a claim that the contract prohibited intervals for Recall@10% or Lift@10% -- the contract is silent on that question. No interval is computed for them now, because doing so after seeing the results would be a new scientific quantity.

suite_provenance.note: e17e5377... is the SHA-256 of the suite AS COMMITTED AND EXECUTED at the pre-execution freeze dfd5b5d. The file has since been edited to re-scope its post-execution semantics: two guards that asserted the real package did not exist are now scoped to that commit, and the live package is verified by hash instead. The historical hash must never be presented as the current file's hash; `test_the_executed_suite_hash_is_recorded_as_historical_not_current` enforces both halves of that statement.
